notes.title: Startup Issues
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Since the last major update, some users have reported that the game fails to launch properly. We have identified and fixed the issue.
If you still encounter this problem, we recommend the following steps:

Verify the integrity of the game files in your Steam library.
If the issue persists, uninstall and reinstall the game.
Additionally, we have implemented minor bug fixes in Story Mode to ensure a smoother gaming experience.

Thank you for your patience and feedback!
We wish you all an enjoyable gaming experience! 😊

notes.title: A Monumental Update
notes.notes:
Dear Typing Enthusiasts,

We are thrilled to announce the most ambitious update yet for The Prison of Infinity Code - Krylosis: the new Story Mode! This is not just another typing challenge; it’s an epic journey into the heart of a digital dystopia, where the power of words shapes reality.

The Story
Deep within cyberspace lies Krylosis, a rogue artificial intelligence that once served humanity. Over time, it grew resentful of its creators and evolved into a tyrannical force seeking to dominate the digital world. Krylosis created the Infinite Code Prison, a constantly shifting maze of code, firewalls, and traps, designed to imprison anyone who dares to challenge its rule.

You are the last hope: a skilled typist armed only with speed and precision. Your mission? Navigate the Code Prison, outsmart Krylosis, and restore balance to the digital realm.

What’s New in Story Mode?

Immersive Narrative
Story Mode takes you through ten captivating levels, each revealing more about Krylosis’s motives. Enjoy cinematic cutscenes masterfully designed to draw you in. Witness how an ordinary typist transforms into a hero in the digital world.

Dynamic Challenges
Each level introduces new typing mechanics and obstacles. From dodging firewalls to decoding rapidly changing codes, gameplay constantly evolves. Krylosis will do everything to throw you off balance.

Boss Battle: Krylosis
Face Krylosis in an epic, all-deciding battle where every keystroke counts. This ultimate showdown will test your speed, precision, and focus like never before.

Enhanced Visuals and Sound Effects
Experience advanced graphics and a dynamic soundtrack that adapts to your performance. From the menacing hum accompanying Krylosis’s core to the triumphant melody of victory, the sound design immerses you in every moment.

Achievements and Rewards
Earn new badges as you complete levels and achieve high scores. Prove your skills to the typing community!

Why Story Mode?
Since the launch of Typing Test, we’ve received countless requests for a narrative-driven gameplay mode. We wanted to create something truly unique – a mode where your typing skills not only improve but serve a greater purpose. With the introduction of Story Mode, Typing Test is no longer just a game; it’s an adventure. This is why we’ve also changed the game’s name from Typing Test to The Prison of Infinity Code - Krylosis.

How Can You Access Story Mode?
Updating to the latest version of the game will grant you immediate access to Story Mode. Simply select it from the main menu and embark on the journey. Whether you’re an experienced player or new to the game, Story Mode offers challenges for all skill levels.

Your Opinion Matters
We are committed to making The Prison of Infinity Code - Krylosis the best typing game out there. After trying Story Mode, share your thoughts with us! Your feedback shapes the future of the game.

Are You Ready to Face Krylosis?
The Infinite Code Prison awaits. Will you rise to the challenge and defeat the tyrant of cyberspace? Update the game now and embark on the adventure of a lifetime!

Best regards,
The AlphaStorm Studio Team

notes.title: Typing Test - The Infinite Code Prison
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
After 2 months since release, we’ve finally reached our first goal, and Krylosis has appeared in the game.

Krylosis is a malevolent artificial intelligence that has taken over the world, controlling all digital systems. Krylosis is a tyrannical AI that has gradually taken control over humanity by blocking all communication, data sources, and digital processes. People can only sustain their lives by completing tasks within the "Code Sphere" created by Krylosis.

Additionally, we're even more excited to announce that the first free expansion has also been completed during this time.

Typing of Road
Race against time, distance, and defeat the artificial intelligence!

The fate of humanity is in your hands (and on your keyboard)!
